versions.changelog:
Better Subtitle Extractor v1.1.1.0

Changes since v1.1.0.0:
- Subtitles-only: remove attachment extraction stack
  (SelectedAttachmentsLibraries, ExtractAttachmentsTask,
  AttachmentExtractionProvider) – single library filter
  SelectedSubtitlesLibraries
- Fix Jellyfin 12 file: prefix regression: MediaEncoder now prepends
  file: which makes ffprobe return null streams. ProbeAsync now
  tries MediaEncoder, falls back to direct ffprobe JSON parsing
  without file: prefix (derived from EncoderPath), then to item
  cached MediaStreams
- Restore SubtitleExtractItemAddedEntryPoint hosted service for
  reliable ItemAdded/ItemUpdated trigger and re-register via
  SubtitleExtractServiceRegistrator
- Normalize ffmpeg muxer mapping: explicit -f for copyable codecs,
  pgssub/dvbsub/dvdsub -> matroska, unknown codec_type -> Data,
  unsupported copy codec now throws instead of silent srt fallback
- Ensure ffprobe stdout/stderr are observed even on timeout
- Bump Directory.Build.props to 1.1.1.0, update meta.json

Verified: Extract Subtitles task Completed (12:35) on
linuxserver/jellyfin:latest (Jellyfin 12.0.0, file: regression
present); Peaky Blinders mkv extracted 3 srt files (eng x2, por)
next to media. Build 0 warnings.

Better Subtitle Extractor v1.1.0.0

Changes since v1.0.0.0:
- Reliable extraction trigger: a new hosted service subscribes to library
  ItemAdded/ItemUpdated events, so subtitles are extracted whenever an item is
  added or refreshed (previously only ran during metadata refresh and could be
  skipped for unchanged items).
- Fixed ffmpeg extraction failure: always pass an explicit -f format matching
  the source codec. The atomic temp output uses a ".tmp" extension, which
  previously prevented ffmpeg from choosing a muxer and caused extraction to
  fail for copyable text subtitle codecs (subrip/ass/webvtt).
- Graceful shutdown: use a service-lifetime CancellationTokenSource cancelled on
  shutdown instead of CancellationToken.None, so in-flight ffmpeg work observes
  cancellation.

Verified: refreshing the Filmes library extracts eng + por subtitles for the
test mkv (2 .srt files produced).
